## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: test_runner_deep_overlays_concurrent only asserts exit code and elapsed time; it does not assert that overlay slot files were actually written (e.g. reviewer-findings-test-quality.json in ARTIFACTS_DEEP_CONC). A fully concurrent path could write nothing to the slot files and the test would still pass.
